title: Baghel Singh Rejects Retreat and Marches for Battle

blocks.text: Baghel Singh answers caution with a stern appeal to honor. With what face would they retreat at that stage, he asks, if the Malwa forces pursued them and turned their misl into an object of ridicule within the Panth.

The decision is then formalized in martial order. Chiefs assemble, the whole Khalsa Panth Misl agreed to obey the battle plan, commanders are assigned to their fronts, and standards and drums signal that hesitation has ended.

By the close of the page the Khalsa has moved from debate to motion. The force marches toward Patiala with discipline, not because danger is denied, but because retreat would wound the misl more deeply than combat.
